discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
subfield: Condensed matter physics: topological phases of matter
motivation: Kane and Mele showed in 2005 that spin-orbit coupling can produce a time-reversal-invariant topological insulator, the quantum spin Hall state. They introduced the Z2 invariant, which established that ordinary non-magnetic band insulators come in topologically distinct classes. In 2007 Molenkamp's group observed quantized edge conduction in HgTe quantum wells, the first experimental realization. These papers created a new field. The theory was extended to three dimensions and led to the discovery of Bi2Se3-family materials with protected Dirac surface states. It also led to topological superconductors, Weyl semimetals, symmetry-protected topological phases and the systematic topological classification of all band structures. Few ideas have so completely changed what condensed-matter physicists look for in materials. Topology is now a standard part of materials characterization. It also underlies routes to Majorana modes and topological quantum computation. The work is conceptually profound, precisely predictive and experimentally confirmed.
